'''Allat Za''' was the [[Chief/Legends|Chieftain]] of the [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] [[Species/Legends|species]] when the residents of the Quarren [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Dac/Legends|Dac]] first encountered the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] over 120 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after [[4500 BBY]]. Dac was given the option to join the Republic, which the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]], another [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] species from Dac, supported. Za, however, opposed joining the Republic and forced the incumbent Mon Calamari [[Unidentified Mon Calamari king|king]] to instead make Dac an independent state that was allied with the Republic. Za's achievement was viewed as a victory by the Quarren, but they nonetheless began to feel increasingly marginalized by the Mon Calamari as [[Time/Legends|time]] went on.<ref name="Strongholds" />

==Behind the scenes==
Allat Za was mentioned in the [[2015]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying]]'' sourcebook ''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]'', which was published by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] as part of the [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion (roleplaying game)|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'']] [[roleplaying game]].<ref name="Strongholds" />
